thread:
alyssa: Heads up — us-central synthetic embeddings probe started spiking on handshake failures ~02:10 UTC, alert flood coming in. Not user-facing yet but noisy.
probe-bot: ALERT blackbox_probe_failure region=us-central probe=embeddings-stream failures=48/5m failure_type=handshake_timeout link=https://grafana/reports/xyz
sam: on it. can someone paste the prom query used by the probe dashboard?
alyssa: prom: `sum by(region) (increase(blackbox_probe_failures_total{probe=\"embeddings-stream\"}[15m]))`
maria: saw sidecar logs showing `sidecar_conn_reset` and a lot of short lived TLS handshakes around the same time. Could be rate limiter + connection churn.
jon: also seeing sidecar CPU spike >85% on probe pods in us-central during the window. streaming websocket setup is expensive when repeated.
sam: current probe config is 5rps per region with no jitter. that's a lot of connection churn at scale. we should throttle and add jitter ASAP.
alyssa: mitigation plan (short): 1) reduce probe rate in us-central to 1rps and add token-bucket jitter 2) make probe reuse WS for multiple payloads 3) relax alert to require sustained 3m spike before paging.
maria: quick config change ready: edit configmap `probe-embeddings-config` -> `{ "rate": 1, "burst": 2, "jitter_ms": 500 }`. I'll push.
sam: rolling update command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/probe-embeddings-us-central` — will do a canary first.
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/probe-embeddings-us-central by sam at 02:34 UTC
jon: after canary CPU dropped to ~45% on updated pods and handshake failures returned to baseline.
alyssa: nice. let's also change alerting: set the blackbox probe alert to threshold 5/min and add `for: 3m` so noise doesn't page infra.
maria: proposal: add a Grafana composite panel that overlays probe_failures, sidecar_cpu, and rate_limiter_429s and annotate probe conf changes for quick triage.
sam: pushing a code change to probe: connection reuse + backoff jitter. PR: https://git/repo/pull/412 — added unit tests for WS reuse.
jon: FYI p99 latency for a handful of customers in us-central had a +20ms blip during spike window. not obviously related but flagged customer metrics for 24h watch.
alyssa: we'll monitor for 24h. if stable we keep the lower sampling and connection reuse. if we still see noise, consider moving probes to a separate nodepool with lower-cost instances.
maria: also opened a quick cost estimate: probes in aggregate are accounting for non-trivial egress + CPU. moving to 0.5rps regional or adaptive sampling could save ~$X/day. added to tickets.
sam: leaving a note in infra runbook: probe jitter + reuse is now default for embeddings streaming probes. will follow up with postmortem if this recurs.
alyssa: thanks all. closing for now — will reopen if probe-bot flips again. :thumbsup:
